# prismasdwan_element_bgp_config (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Prisma SD-WAN Element Bgp Config items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample data source example for "element_bgp_config".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

data "prismasdwan_element_bgp_config" "example" {
  # Select an item by matching one or more of its attributes.
  filters = {
    # e.g. name = "example"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `filters` (Map of String) Path parameters used to locate the items to retrieve.

### Optional

- `x_etag` (Number) Entity tag returned by the API, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Additional path parameters for the data source, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version returned by the API, managed automatically by the provider.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The list of items returned by the data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

Read-Only:

- `admin_distance` (Number) Admin distance. Value: between 1 and 255.

- `maximum_paths` (Number) Maximum paths. Value: between 1 and 255.
- `md5_secret` (String, Sensitive) Md5 secret. Value: at most 32 characters.
- `multi_hop_limit` (Number) Multi hop limit. Value: between 1 and 255.

- `prefix_adv_type_to_lan` (String) Prefix adv type to lan.
- `prefixes_to_adv_to_wan` (List of String) Prefixes to adv to wan.

- `vrf_router_id_map` (Attributes List) Vrf router id map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--vrf_router_id_map))
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
